The '''wife''' of [[Jorem Yange]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was one of [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Darth Baras' spy network|infiltrators]]. She was captured by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Somminick Timmns]] in [[3653 BBY]], and Yange was ordered by Baras to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her when she started spilling information.
